title: When the Hollow Burns Again
author: Ada Ravensworth
blurb: Felix Iversen, the youngest member of a dying guild, has spent fifteen years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
